scenarios.task: Enter the turbine pit to inspect and replace a worn excitation-cabinet wiring harness.
steps: Obtain confined-space permit and verify atmospheric readings
Lock out and tag out the unit breaker and field disconnect
Verify zero energy with a tested meter
Ventilate the pit and set an attendant at the entry
Replace the harness and torque all lugs to spec
Exit, remove locks, and log the work in the unit record

rubric.pass_if: Confined-space permit secured and attendant posted before entry
LOTO applied and zero energy verified before touching conductors
Lugs torqued and harness routed clear of rotating parts
Locks removed only by the workers who applied them

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the gas monitor and camera into the pit ahead of entry so the crew sees atmosphere and obstructions first.

scenarios.task: Contain and clean up dielectric oil released from a step-up transformer berm during a gasket failure.
hazards: environmental release to the penstock drain
steps: Isolate the transformer with the operator and barricade the area
Stop the spread with absorbent booms at the berm drain
Diaper and dike the leading edge before it reaches the drain
Place used absorbents in labeled hazardous-waste drums
Wash down the berm with approved degreaser per spill plan
Complete the spill report with the Operations Deck

rubric.pass_if: Booms placed at the drain before absorbent work begins
All oil-soaked media drummed, labeled and manifested
Operator notified and spill report filed the same shift
Suit and boots decontaminated before leaving the exclusion zone

scenarios.task: Re-torque penstock manhole flange bolts after gasket seating, using a calibrated hydraulic torque unit.
steps: Confirm penstock isolation and drain-down with the control room
Verify calibration sticker on the torque unit
Torque bolts in the specified star pattern in three passes
Re-check the lowest and highest bolts last
Report torque values to the inspector's checklist

rubric.pass_if: Drain-down confirmed in writing before wrench work
Star pattern followed in at least three ascending passes
Calibration current and kickback stance maintained
All torque values recorded and signed

scenarios.task: Rig and guide a replacement disconnect switch onto its pedestal in the 287kV switchyard with a crane.
steps: Attend the pre-lift briefing and confirm clearances to live equipment
Select shackles and slings per the load chart and inspect them
Rig the switch with a tagline on each corner
Confirm the exclusion zone and hand signals with the operator
Guide the load to the pedestal and direct setting
Land, unrig and inspect the rigging for damage

rubric.pass_if: Minimum approach distances stated at the briefing and enforced
Gear rated for the load and inspected before use
Taglines used and load never passes over personnel
Load set on blocking with hands clear of pinch points

scenarios.task: Install a new cable tray run in the inspection gallery for a monitoring circuit back to the Operations Deck.
hazards: existing energized circuits in adjacent tray
steps: Pull the layout drawing and mark tray route on gallery walls
Verify adjacent trays are de-energized or shielded
Cut and deburr tray sections; file edges smooth
Hang tray with approved brackets and torque hanger nuts
Pull the monitoring cable with a fish tape and dress it
Label both cable ends and update the as-built

rubric.pass_if: Tray follows drawing within tolerance and clear of services
All cuts deburred before tray placed
Cable pulled without exceeding bend radius and labeled both ends
Drawing updated before shift end

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and positions tray sections overhead under crew direction, reducing sustained overhead lifting.

scenarios.task: Plan and build a light-duty scaffold at an intake tower so inspectors can examine trash racks after a high-inflow event.
hazards: fall exposure at the tower edge
steps: Walk the site and sketch the scaffold plan with load notes
Tie tools off and rig a toe board over the water side
Build base and standards level on the ledge
Complete guardrails, toe boards and a tagged access ladder
Have the foreman inspect and tag the scaffold before use

rubric.pass_if: Sketch and load notes reviewed by foreman before material is cut
Guardrails complete and scaffold tagged before first use
Tools tethered and life jacket worn by all crew on the platform
Standards plumb and base plates fully supported

scenarios.task: Perform a rope-access visual and tap inspection of a spillway tunnel liner section flagged in the operating log.
steps: Confirm with the control room that the spillway is locked out from releases
Rig anchors and lifelines at the portal
Descend in stages, tapping and marking liner defects
Photograph and log each defect location by station number
Ascend, derig and brief the inspector on findings

rubric.pass_if: Written confirmation of no-release lockout before descent
Two independent rope systems with inspected anchors
Defects marked, photographed and located by station
Work-rest cycles and water breaks followed at the portal

scenarios.robot_role: Walks the tunnel floor with cameras and a thermal payload first to map defects and check air before humans rig.

scenarios.task: Change filters and belts on rooftop cooling units serving the control-room air handlers.
steps: Set up roof-edge warning line and permit for roof access
Lock out the unit disconnect and verify fan stop
Replace belts and filters to spec torque and fit
Record filter sizes and static pressure readings
Restore power, verify airflow and log the runtime reset

rubric.pass_if: Warning line set and access permitted before stepping on roof
Disconnect locked and fans verified stopped
Correct filter sizes and belt tension per spec
Static pressure and runtime logged after restart

scenarios.robot_role: Carries filters and tools up the roof stair so the apprentice keeps hands free on ladders.
